worked: Federal AGI = wages 265,000.00 = 265,000.00. Federal taxable income = 265,000.00 - 31,500.00 standard deduction = 233,500.00 (given, not tested; federal senior deduction ignored). RI-1040 line 1 federal AGI 265,000.00. Line 1y total decreasing modifications = 0.00. Line 2a other-state obligations 0.00; line 2m total increasing modifications = 0.00. Schedule M page 2 line 3 net = 0.00 - 0.00 = 0.00; RI-1040 line 2 = 0.00. Line 3 modified federal AGI = 265,000.00 + (0.00) = 265,000.00. Standard Deduction and Exemption Worksheets: worksheet line 5 = 265,000.00 - 254,250.00 = 10,750.00, not more than 29,000; line 6 = 10,750.00 / 7,250 = 1.4827586, raised to 2; line 7 = 0.6000. Line 4 standard deduction: 21,800.00 (Married filing jointly) x 0.6000 = 13,080.00. Line 5 = 265,000.00 - 13,080.00 = 251,920.00. Line 6 exemptions: 2 x 5,100.00 = 10,200.00 x 0.6000 = 6,120.00. Line 7 taxable income = 251,920.00 - 6,120.00 = 245,800.00. Line 8 tax on 245,800.00 by the schedule as numbers: 79,900.00 x 0.0375 = 2996.2500 + 101,750.00 x 0.0475 = 4833.1250 + 64,150.00 x 0.0599 = 3842.585000 = 11,671.96. Credits 0.00 (Schedule I, Schedule II, RI earned income credit and RI-1040H are not modelled and not claimed here). Rhode Island income tax = 11,671.96.
